name: semgrep
description: Fast, open-source static analysis tool for finding bugs, detecting security vulnerabilities, and enforcing code standards across 30+ languages

semgrep.description: Lightweight static analysis tool with pattern-based scanning for security vulnerabilities and code quality issues
semgrep.usage:
semgrep --help
semgrep --config=auto .
semgrep --config=p/security-audit .
semgrep --config=p/owasp-top-ten .
semgrep --config=p/python ./src
semgrep --output=results.json --json .
semgrep --severity=ERROR .
